statement: He forgot to upgrade the furnace and will do it tomorrow; wants to aim for the big upgrades there later.
After a class reset a character went back to beginner and reached level 400 in one hit on world six mobs.
Claim your free coliseum ticket but don't use the tickets yet.
A quest requires strange rocks so he equips one to farm them.
Reach map three and buy the sculpting tool; goldie boy gives extra bonus.
Speedrun the character to Amarok as soon as possible so he can become a hunter.
Assign talent points into spells and potency to increase kills per run for pushing.
Class XP multiplier now shows in the top left corner as a new UI element.
Attempt Baba Yaga to try for a special drop he needs.
Stay in the session because the leader started it; phasing issue can occur but isn't a problem if not phased from the leader.
Use 20 happy hour passes at once for 20 times the rewards.
Getting fourth frog would be huge for rewards.
Warrior is the best class for party dungeons because of AoE auto attacks.
Carry world tours in world one two three and beating the final boss achievement gives up to about 40% total damage.
Goal is not to die; drop three reagents in front of the cauldron to summon the first boss.
Buy items mid-run for upgrades such as armadillo helping heart and dead book.
Run items give boosts for the run; the D drop gives credits for after the dungeon and flurbo drops help outside dungeons.
Four big frogs summon; the fourth turns grayscale and is an Eldritch frog.
Took sucker punch because he is building a bit of crit chance.
When about to die he respawns and takes the minus two instead of surviving.
Belly would have helped survival; should have grabbed more damage.
People AFK in find party randoms make runs slow and low-rank players hurt progress.
Don't touch the grayscale Eldritch frog stage; just chill.
On his main account he can carry 10 people in one go with some sweat; one or two good players makes it easy.
Anyone under rank 50 usually makes a carry not possible.
Horn of the Fall gives lots of crit damage but you do no damage if you don't crit; good with high crit chance.
Dice rolls give a chance at keychains such as big King Doot ones.
Worth doing one more run because he is getting three time rewards.
Taking start dungeon with two gray RNG items; each gray gives 1% drop chance to get more flurbos.
Max HP and base damage are ideal stat boosts; two defense-giving books are massive for early defense.
One book gives base efficiency for all skills and he rolled it at 88.
Talent point upgrade gives plus five per tab; main focus is accuracy and defense.
Master cash isn't needed and AFK gains are kind of nothing.
Two defense upgrades give seven defense each for 14 total right off the bat.
Find party randoms start without a full group and are bad; he admits find party criticism was right.
Buy Rex rings after defense rings; they give skill efficiency and are among the best rings for a long time.
Get a recipe from Baba Yaga to turn Rex rings into serrated Rex rings which last a long time.
You get more credits than flurbos depending on party size so a smaller party yields less.
Eldritch croakers hit for about 20 per hit so low HP characters get two-tapped.
Divine knight (squire upgrade class) is better for this party dungeon; unlocked on reaching world four.
World three is where things start to take off; world four ramps; world five is a stat stick that gets berserk with RNG.
Needs at least a minute left to kill the last boss unless you have two Horn of the Fall.
Focus base damage and total damage because total damage can't scale without base damage.
For world one grinding the best stats are base damage then total damage then crit chance and drop rarity.
Drop chance and drop rarity are the same thing in this game; upgrades with either name are probably the same.
Buying times 20 was worth it; spend about 20 each on base damage then rest on total damage percent.
Rex rings give 5 skill efficiency each for 10% total but he keeps defense rings for now.
Swap Rex rings onto characters that need to max skills; one reached 116 base efficiency.
Doing the party dungeon gave about 10% total damage percent.
Burning and turning copper ore now; later iron ore and move from oak logs to bleach logs to ramp production.
Party dungeon gave extra talent points that he put into talents.
White screen flashbang is fixed with Control R on Steam or web; likely a memory leak that sets progress back a little.
Spend merit shop points on strength for now and unlock some Amarok stuff.
Desert Davey needs steel axe and birch long quarterstaff; blocked until bleach logs and copper bars.
World three skills are close; needs to kill Amarok two more times to get there.
Normal Amarok card gives skill AFK gains and is good to put on all other characters.
Amarok tasks: defeat with boxing gloves from start; defeat without taking a hit; defeat on first second third in order; these unlock gear crafts.
Amarok body plate hinds and paws require 21 smithing to craft; make threads early to get the XP.
Need 25 slabs on every character; has seven and holds off for now.
Wants sleek shank and steel bands plus a fishing rod and a net; greeds gems for infinity hammer.
Got infinity hammer then four brimstone upgrades so he produces three items at a time.
Swap every character to produce three items to stock production materials so a long absence doesn't hurt even though XP is worse.
Stamps weren't done today; not needed yet because some farming is needed first but will be a focus.
Push the character to Amarok to reach his subclass pushing and goblins are quick for the remaining 18 kills.
The vault makes the early game much easier; he's getting used to it.
Anvil can have 16 slots in total; wants to get to a plat; anvil XP gain is pretty good.
Extra bar chance is huge because it saves resources; card drop chance is also nice.
Still needs to do Baba Yaga and a couple of other things; so much to do on the islands that it's easy to forget.
Walking sticks is a really good AFK XP spot and its base materials can be sold.
Baba Yaga now spawns once a day instead of every hour; he used a 1 hour time candy for serrated Rex rings.
Don't use coliseum tickets for Baba Yaga; he considers that a waste.
House flipper gives an RNG item for party dungeons.
Steam-only achievement keep the oil precious oil gives 10 gems and a 1 hour time candy.
Frog achievements give total damage: 2% first frog and 3% and 5% for later frogs for 10%; fourth frog adds 5% more.
Do your party dungeons; they are really important.
Defense rings give an extra 14 defense which is substantial in the early game.
Active XP doesn't show in overall class XP but still works.
Swap to a card preset giving 5% skill AFK gains and Amarok card since farming Amarok.
Should have put more points in Piercing Arrow for more kills per hour.
Dungeonic damage gives damage based on credits earned in party dungeons; basically free 10% and raised damage from 15k to 18.2k.
Main pusher is a squire because of very low MP usage thanks to shockwave and good for active clearing.
Bowman on flies; one chopping; copper being mined then iron for Amarok armor bars; push to Amarok then hunter subclass.
Next day plan is working on stamps and getting past a couple of maps toward the next boss.
